- Gallery: zooming a picture could turn the screen black and leave the gallery stuck. The picture is now handled the way the Fossify Gallery does it (its zoom view reads only the part on the screen from the file): the base picture is smaller (2048 px, two kept instead of three), and once you zoom in the sharp part that is on the screen is read straight from the file at the sharpness the zoom needs (EXIF turn taken into account), laid over the base so it follows your fingers; zoom goes up to 10x.
- Game Hub: back from a game, the open case's GPU drawing is thrown away at once (the GPU can leave it black or never let it land), the case is closed with its box shown again, and the next open builds a new one; a flight of the case back to its box that has not landed after 3.5 seconds is ended by force, so no black area is left where the box was.
- Keyboard: the first word of a message (and any word with a capital) got no suggestions at all: the word was counted twice in the check for links and code ("GünaydınGünaydın" looked like code because of "nG"), so the bar stayed empty. Fixed.
